title: Point realization comparison by module functor composition
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring, T affine, and component inverse image continuous braided and finite-exact. Given beta and alpha as in [lem-zl-component-section-realization], the profinite point-scalar realization followed by componentDerived Lambda T alpha is naturally isomorphic to the affine point-scalar realization. Weak contractibility is not needed. The underlying definitions are those of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model].

proof.text: Lift β to module objects with Functor.mapModCompIso. The coefficient map of this lift equals α.hom by hα. Composing its restriction of scalars with α.inv cancels by α.inv_hom_id; Mod.comapComp, Mod.comapCongr and Mod.comapId give the ordinary module functor isomorphism.

Use exactness to pass the ordinary isomorphism to the unbounded derived categories with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Whisker it by the common derived constant-module functor, coefficient extension and exact internal-module equivalence. Functor associators identify precisely the fixed profinite and affine point realizations.
